name: Utsunomiya (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with a white crest of the character 宮 within a stylised frame.
history: The flag of Utsunomiya bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Utsunomiya municipal emblem — a white crest of the character 宮 within a stylised frame
